description: The bar chart illustrates the number of parameters in various long-context large language models (LLMs), categorized by input and output context sizes of 2K, 4K, 8K, and 16K. The vertical axis represents the number of parameters, ranging from 0 to 120,000, while the horizontal axis displays the different model configurations. Each model configuration is represented by two bars: one for the input context (labeled "Input") and one for the output context (labeled "Output"), with distinct colors for each context size. The 4K-Output model has the highest number of parameters at 108,494, followed by the 2K-Input model with 78,188 parameters. The 8K-Output model has 17,865 parameters, and the 16K-Output model has 4,247 parameters. The 2K-Input model has 9,320 parameters, the 4K-Input model has 3,784 parameters, the 8K-Input model has 1,401 parameters, and the 16K-Input model has 832 parameters. The chart clearly shows that the number of parameters varies significantly across different model configurations, with the 4K-Output model having the highest number of parameters.
